title: Eating Out: From Menu to Bill

sections.title: Part 1 · Vocabulary test
sections.sub: Chọn hoặc điền từ / cụm từ đã học.

sections.title: Part 2 · Reading — A review: The Blue Fish
sections.sub: Đọc đoạn văn rồi trả lời câu hỏi.
sections.passage:
The Blue Fish is a small restaurant near the river. When you arrive, the waiter gives you the menu and a glass of water.

To start with, I recommend the tomato soup. It is hot, fresh and only £4. For the main course, you can choose fish, chicken or a vegetable dish. The fish and chips is the most popular dish, and the portion is very large! Every main course comes with a side dish: chips, rice or a green salad.

The waiters are friendly. If you have a food allergy, tell them. They can make most dishes without nuts, cheese or onions. However, the chocolate cake contains nuts.

When you ask for the bill, check it carefully, because there is a ten per cent service charge. With friends, you can split the bill easily. A meal for two usually costs about £40.

sections.title: Part 3 · Listening — Ordering at a café
sections.sub: Nghe và trả lời. Script hiện ra sau khi nộp bài.

items.prompt: What does the waiter recommend?
The burger comes with…
The customer eats meat.
Why does she ask for no nuts?
Her main course: the vegetable ____
Her starter:
Her drink:
The bill is ____ pounds.

script: Hi, are you ready to order?
Yes, I think so. What do you recommend?
The beef burger is very popular. It comes with a side dish of chips or salad.
Hmm, I'm vegetarian. Is there a vegetarian main course?
Yes, the vegetable curry. However, it contains nuts.
Oh no, I have a food allergy. Could I have it without nuts?
Great. I'll have the vegetable curry, then, with rice. And to start with, a green salad, please.
Excuse me, could I have the bill, please?
Of course. That's twenty-one pounds, with the service charge.

sections.title: Part 4 · Speaking — Shadowing
sections.sub: Nghe mẫu → đọc theo → ghi âm. Máy chấm điểm trên thang 10 và tô màu từng từ.

items.prompt: Order a meal in a restaurant

sentences.text: Good evening. Could we see the menu, please?
To start with, I'll have the tomato soup.
For the main course, I'd like the grilled chicken with rice.
I have a food allergy. Could I have it without nuts?
Could we have the bill, please? Could we split it?
